;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2018 Gaza border protests]]
**On [[Quds Day]] – the last Friday of [[Ramadan]] – thousands of [[Palestinians]] protest near the [[Israel–Gaza barrier|Gaza border fence]]. [[Israel]]i troops fire live rounds and tear gas, killing four people and injuring over 600. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/israel-palestinians-clash-gaza-border-jerusalem-day-idf-blames-hamas/ (AP via CBS News)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)]]
**A [[United States|U.S.]] [[Special Forces (United States Army)|special forces]] soldier is killed and four others are wounded in an ambush by suspected [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] militants near the town of [[Jamame]], [[Lower Juba]], [[Somalia]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-44421488 (BBC)] 

;Arts and culture
*[[Weinstein effect]]
**[[The Walt Disney Company]] announces that its [[animation]] chief, [[John Lasseter]], will leave the company after December 31, after he was accused of misconduct late last year. [https://deadline.com/2018/06/john-lassteter-leaving-disney-end-of-2018-1202406682/ (''Deadline'')]

;Business and economy 
*[[Economy of the United Kingdom]]
**[[Gavin Patterson]], the chief executive of [[BT Group]], announces that he intends to step down later this year. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-44410114 (BBC)]
*[[Economy of Japan]]
**Due to a change in [[Japan]]ese legislation, [[Airbnb]] announces that it will be cancelling thousands of reservations made in the country. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-44409187 (BBC)]

;International relations
*[[Embassy attack accusations in Cuba]]
**The [[United States]] expand their health alert from [[Guangzhou]] to all of [[China]], after it repatriated multiple employees with symptoms resembling a brain injury. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-usa-illness/u-s-expands-china-health-alert-amid-illness-reports-idUSKCN1J408E (Reuters)]
*[[Russia–United States relations]]
**The military chiefs of both countries, [[Joseph Dunford]] and [[Valery Gerasimov]], meet in [[Finland]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/us-russian-military-leaders-meet-finland-55743405 (AP via ABC News)]
*[[44th G7 summit]]
**Leaders from the [[Group of Seven]] meet in [[La Malbaie]], [[Quebec]], [[Canada]] to discuss issues facing their countries, including trade between the [[United States]] and [[European Union]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-g7-summit/u-s-eu-agree-to-start-technical-talks-on-trade-after-g7-summit-standoff-idUSKCN1J408Q (Reuters)]
**[[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] calls for [[Russia]], which was suspended from the [[Group of Eight|group]] after the [[Annexation of Crimea by the Russian Federation|annexation of Crimea in 2014]], to be reinstated in the group; a call supported by the Prime Minister of Italy [[Giuseppe Conte]], and rejected by most other G7 leaders. [http://www.dw.com/en/european-nations-reject-trumps-call-to-readmit-russia-to-g7/a-44121851 (Deutsche Welle)]

;Law and crime
*[[Jean-Pierre Bemba]] is acquitted of [[war crime]]s by the [[International Criminal Court]] appeals chamber. [https://apnews.com/dccea3babfed4e08a478efa9e93c1ebf (AP)]
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**A U.S. federal judge blocks until June 20 the release in [[Syrian Democratic Forces]]-controlled territory of a dual-nationality [[Saudi Arabia|Saudi]]-[[United States|American]] citizen alleged to have joined [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]]. The man, who is now held for nine months in [[Iraq]], was planned to be released by the U.S. military – with a new cell phone, some food and water and $4,210 in cash, but with no identification – as soon as tomorrow. [http://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/Middle-East/2018/Jun-08/452600-judge-questions-plan-to-release-us-detainee-into-syrian-war-zone.ashx (AFP via ''The Daily Star'')] [http://www.wlns.com/ap-top-news/government-will-hold-off-releasing-american-back-to-syria/1226479284 (AP via WLNS)]
* [[Killing of Susanna Feldman]]
**Ali Bashar, the main suspect in the murder and rape case of a 14-year-old German-Jewish girl in [[Wiesbaden]], Germany is arrested by [[Iraqi Kurdistan|Kurdish]] forces in Northern [[Iraq]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/suspect-in-murder-of-german-jewish-teen-arrested-in-iraq/ (''Times of Israel'')]

;Science and technology
*[[TOP500]]
**The 10-[[megawatt]] [[IBM]] [[Summit (supercomputer)|Summit]] [[supercomputer]] is unveiled at [[Oak Ridge National Laboratory]], [[East Tennessee]]. With a reported 200 [[Peta-|peta]][[FLOPS|flops]] of processing power, it is expected to top the list of the world's most powerful computers after this June's update is presented at the [[International Supercomputing Conference]]. [https://www.wired.com/story/the-us-again-has-worlds-most-powerful-supercomputer/ (''Wired'')]

;Sport
*[[2018 NBA Finals]]
**In basketball, the [[Golden State Warriors]] defeat the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]] in four games to win the [[National Basketball Association]] Championship. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/06/08/sports/nba-finals-warriors-cavs.html?emc=edit_na_20180608&nl=breaking-news&nlid=80824687ing-news&ref=cta (''New York Times'')]
